modelDescription: MDT AICS pattern magazines for your bolt action rifle. Available in polymer, metal, and polymetal. Our AICS mags feed ammunition reliably into your rifle. Available in 3 to 12 round capacity, different colors and with multiple calibers including 308 Winchester, 6.5 Creedmoor, 223 Remington, and 338 Lapua Mag.
